content.title: Pavilion Rental | La Crosse County, WI | High Point Retreats
content.text: About Welcome to High Point Retreats LLC. We invite you to share our hand built retreats perched on the highest ridge-top in all of La Crosse county. Our 20+ acre property is located in the Driftless region of southwest WI. Take in the picturesque view, the solitude of nature and immerse yourself in the tranquility that our property has to offer. Tim also recently renovated a new retreat located on Brice Prairie in Onalaska, WI for guests to enjoy close access to the Mississippi River and Great River State Trail. Prairie View Ranch Retreat is hosted by High Point Retreats LLC and is great for larger group wanting closer stays to attractions in Onalaska and La Crosse.Prior to opening in September 2020, High Point Retreats was something that owner, Tim Adamson, wanted to share with as many people as possible. From the amazing sunset view, to the restorative aspects being surrounded in nature created, it was an experience too good not to share. Tim wanted others to have the reconnection to self and their loved ones from the simple act of unplugging and connecting with nature that he has enjoyed for years. Tim’s personal touch and vintage antique collection is carefully crafted into each retreat. Don't just visit one of the highest elevations in all of La Crosse County, stay at one of the highest elevations in all of La Crosse County! High Point Retreats is located at an elevation of 1360 feet. Enjoy your private retreat with a one of a kind view. We hope to see you soon! All retreats are located along the same, secluded, low traffic ridgeline and are within walking distance from each other. Perfect for couples, multi family or friend getaways! Rent one, multiple, or all retreats. We Support Local Business We are a locally owned business, that supports other local businesses in the surrounding area. When you stay with us, you will enjoy small touches crafted by local area artisans. Some of the local businesses we support include: Driftless Skincare (Downtown La Crosse)Treklist Adventures (Holmen)La Crosse Clay Center (La Crosse)Pencil Pics by Daryl (Viroqua)Good Earth Soap (Green Bay)Larson's General (Downtown La Crosse)Wildly Authentic (Holmen) *To become one of our local area artisans, contact us at highpoint1360@gmail.com.
